description: Saves changes to a saved Contacts view, as the view's Save changes does: version (from the view you read) is required and refuses the save if someone changed it since (stale_view, never merged); send only the fields to change (name, query, presentation, visibility, people). Changing who a team view is shared with can be refused with campaigns_follow_view when campaigns follow the view, then again with confirmFollowers: true. Deleting a view stays a person's control in the app. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: edit_contact_view
title: Save changes to a Contacts view
